title: Java Back End Developer with AWS_Infosys
description:
Hiring Java Backend Developers | 5-10 Yrs | Spring Boot & AWS 
 Location: PAN INDIA
 Experience: 5-10 Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time 
 Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Java Backend Developer with strong expertise in Spring Boot and AWS to build scalable, cloud-native applications and microservices. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in backend development, cloud deployments, API development, and distributed systems. 
 Must-Have Skills 5-10 years of hands-on experience in Java backend development Strong proficiency in Java 8/11/17 Extensive experience with Spring Boot , Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Security Strong hands-on experience with AWS Cloud services such as EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, IAM, and CloudWatch Experience designing and developing Microservices Architecture Expertise in building and consuming RESTful APIs Strong experience with SQL and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or DynamoDB Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar tools Strong knowledge of data structures, design patterns, and system design principles Proficiency with Git, code reviews, and Agile development methodologies Experience with Kafka/RabbitMQ or other messaging systems Good understanding of application security including OAuth2, JWT, and secure coding practices Experience in performance tuning, monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting production applications 
 Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Java and Spring Boot. Build and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS. Develop secure and high-performance REST APIs and microservices. Participate in architecture discussions and technical design reviews. Optimize application performance, reliability, and scalability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle. Ensure code quality through unit testing, code reviews, and best engineering practices. Support production environments and resolve complex technical issues. 
 What Makes You a Strong Fit Strong backend development expertise with modern Java frameworks. Proven experience in building enterprise-scale applications on AWS. Ability to work independently and drive technical solutions end-to-end. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Key Skills: End,Spring Boot,Java,Backend,Development,AWS,Spring,Boot
